before: An untracked deleteText that covered an inline content control and reached past it kept the emptied wrapper as a zero-width shell with no prompt. A deletion inside a control showing its prompt removed letters of the prompt, or left an empty control still flagged as showing one.
after: deleteText unwraps every inline control it covers and reaches past (markers it held stay in the paragraph); an sdtLocked wrapper stays and shows its prompt. The innermost control holding the whole range shows its prompt when emptied. A prompt the range reaches into is written back whole, with the text it showed.
reason: The op and its replicated form are unchanged; the applier's result for the same deleteText changes, and every replica runs the same applier.
